facts.text: West Lafayette's public library began archiving local history in 1921 and now hosts a dedicated Local History and Archive Collection Department.
In 2023, West Lafayette hired its first full‑time Local History Librarian, marking a new era of professional stewardship for the city’s archives.
The Caretaker’s Cottage at 1496 Salisbury St. reopened for the 2026 season as a historic venue for local history events.
West Lafayette sits across the Wabash River from Lafayette, making it a classic college town home to Purdue University.
West Lafayette never gained a railroad depot, lagging several years behind Lafayette in municipal infrastructure development.
The West Lafayette Public Library’s mission is to collect the community’s written and audio‑visual heritage, actively serving researchers and partners.
